library_preparation_preflight.summary: langchain4j-cohere mirrors the already-merged langchain4j-voyage-ai pattern: an embedding + scoring model over an overridable baseUrl HTTP client. All POM dependencies (langchain4j-core, langchain4j-http-client, langchain4j-http-client-jdk, jackson-annotations) are transitive and resolve via the normal testImplementation on the library coordinate. Tests can run fully offline against an in-process com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer fake with a dummy API key, as langchain4j-voyage-ai's test already demonstrates — no Docker image, no extra Maven coordinate, no environment/system property needed.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Point CohereEmbeddingModel/CohereScoringModel builders at a local com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer (baseUrl(...)) with a dummy apiKey("test-api-key"), following tests/src/dev.langchain4j/langchain4j-voyage-ai/1.21.0-beta31's test as the template — no real network calls or credentials required.
